mapper.sql: R.RECEIPT_ID AS receiptId, R.RECEIPT_TITL AS receiptTitl, R.ORGNZT_ID AS orgnztId, OG.ORGNZT_NM AS orgnztNm, R.REL_ORGNZT_ID1 AS relOrgnztId1, R1.ORGNZT_NM AS relOrgnztNm1, R.REL_ORGNZT_ID2 AS relOrgnztId2, R2.ORGNZT_NM AS relOrgnztNm2, R.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, R.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, R.REG_DT AS regDt, R.UPD_USER_ID AS updUserId, R.UPD_DT AS updDt

FROM LAW_COURT_RECEIPT R LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO OG ON OG.ORGNZT_ID = R.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO R1 ON R1.ORGNZT_ID = R.REL_ORGNZT_ID1 LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO R2 ON R2.ORGNZT_ID = R.REL_ORGNZT_ID2
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_COURT_RECEIPT R WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_COURT_RECEIPT SET RECEIPT_TITL = #{receiptTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REL_ORGNZT_ID1 = #{relOrgnztId1, jdbcType=CHAR}, REL_ORGNZT_ID2 = #{relOrgnztId2, jdbcType=CHAR}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId, jdbcType=CHAR}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE RECEIPT_ID = #{receiptId}
